rationale: Damage to policyholder's own vehicle (hood and windshield) from a fallen tree. While the source is a tree on their own property, the subject of the claim is vehicle damage, making auto coverage the appropriate channel. Policy includes auto coverage and this falls within typical comprehensive/collision scenarios.
claim_summary: POL-1005 (Riley Kim): Own maple tree fell in wind overnight and struck parked vehicle in driveway, damaging hood and windshield. Medium severity. $1,000 deductible, $400k limit. Tree did not strike house.

case_facts.source_of_damage: own maple tree blown over by wind
